identificationModule.officialTitle: To Evaluate a Phase III Study of OH2 Versus Investigator-selected Salvage Chemotherapy or Best Supportive Care in Melanoma Patients Who Had Failed Standard Therapy

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the efficacy of OH2 injection in patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma who have failed at least second-line standard therapy, using investigator-selected salvage chemotherapy or best supportive care (BSC) as controls.

armGroups.label: OH2
armGroups.description: OH2: 10\^7 CCID50/mL intratumoral injection, once every 2 weeks;

armGroups.label: Salvage chemotherapy or best supportive care
armGroups.description: Salvage chemotherapy (single or combined, including but not limited to dacarbazine, temozolomide, taxoid, or platinum) or best supportive care selected by the investigator
interventionNames: Drug: Salvage chemotherapy or best supportive care

interventions.name: Salvage chemotherapy or best supportive care
interventions.description: single or combined, including but not limited to dacarbazine, temozolomide, taxoid, or platinum
armGroupLabels: Salvage chemotherapy or best supportive care

primaryOutcomes.description: Overall survival is defined as the interval from first dose to death from any cause.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of randomization until the date of death from any cause，assessed up to 3 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: Determination of the ORR is calculated based on the proportion of patients achieving CR or PR using the RECIST v1.1 and iRECIST as assessed by investigators.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Tumor assessments were performed every 8 weeks in first year and every 12 weeks thereafter until confirmed PD, start of new anticancer treatment, death, withdrawal of informed consent, loss of follow-up, or the end of the study, assessed up to 3 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: DCR is defined as the percentage of participants with a best overall response of CR, PR, or SD.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Tumor assessments were performed every 8 weeks in first year and every 12 weeks thereafter until confirmed PD, start of new anticancer treatment, death, withdrawal of informed consent, loss of follow-up, or the end of the study, assessed up to 3 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: Progression-free survival is defined as the time from first dose to the earlier event of confirmed PD or death from any cause.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of randomization until the date of first documented progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 3 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: DRR is defined as the percentage of participants with a best overall response of CR or PR using the RECIST/iRECIST assessment with a duration of response of at least 6 months.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Tumor assessments were performed every 8 weeks in first year and every 12 weeks thereafter until confirmed PD, start of new anticancer treatment, death, withdrawal of informed consent, loss of follow-up, or the end of the study，assessed up to 3 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: DOR is defined as the time from the first recording of remission (CR or PR) to the first recording of disease progression or death (whichever comes first)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Tumor assessments were performed every 8 weeks in first year and every 12 weeks thereafter until confirmed PD, start of new anticancer treatment, death, withdrawal of informed consent, loss of follow-up, or the end of the study，assessed up to 3 years
